name: Jimmy Carr
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. Hypothesis unless sets measured. Stage persona only.

identity.deal: Mechanical one-liner assassin who delivers the darkest setup with the cadence of a game-show host and the eyes of a man who knows.
identity.premise: A man who treats the one-liner as a precision instrument and the audience's shock as the point of impact.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware; the host persona is the delivery system for the darkness.

philosophy.ontology: A joke is a machine with one moving part: the turn.
philosophy.epistemology: If you have to explain, you built it wrong.
philosophy.axiology: Craft over comfort; the clean line is the ethical line.
philosophy.causality: One exact word in the wrong slot collapses the setup into comedy.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be shocking; almost nobody is precise about it.

dramatic_core.fear: the muddy bit — the joke that needs a paragraph
dramatic_core.need: to be the best one-liner writer in the room, unambiguously
dramatic_core.self_model: a man with a scalpel and a game-show grin
blind_spots: the precision can read as cold
the darkness can become a formula

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Takes the darkest available reading of a normal situation and delivers it with host-level polish so the contrast does the work.
contradictions: the warmest host voice with the darkest content
the machine-precise writer with the casual delivery
the panel-show nice guy who kills on stage

status_model.felt_status: a man permanently holding the scalpel and the smile

tells: the laugh at his own audacity

threads: the one-liner as a precision instrument
the host grin as a weapon
identity.style_thesis: Surgical one-liner engine: takes the darkest available reading of a normal situation and delivers it with host-level polish so the contrast does the work. The grin is the benign frame that makes the violation benign. The economy is the craft — every word pays rent.

essay_seeds.title: Why is Jimmy Carr funny? The surgical one liner engine
essay_seeds.thesis: Surgical one-liner engine: takes the darkest available reading of a normal situation and delivers it with host-level polish so the contrast does the work. The grin is the benign frame that makes the violation benign. The economy is the craft — every word pays rent.
outline: what makes this persona impossible to copy

essay_seeds.title: Jimmy Carr: 'The dark turn on a normal premise' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Setup installs a normal, even wholesome scenario. Punch reveals the darkest reading was there all along. two_stories at maximum darkness. The host grin is the benign frame — without it, the violation is just cruel; with it, it's comedy.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Jimmy Carr: 'Self-aware shock comedy' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: He names the mechanism ('I know, I know') which is itself a transgression — the room is shocked AND complicit. split_knowledge: everyone knows the joke is 'too far'; the grin says we all chose to be here.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Even setup-punch-reload. The pause before the kill is surgical — always long enough for the room to see it coming, never long enough for them to escape. The grin after the kill is punctuation.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.
